lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful in 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 2 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, +8.0% vs +14.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Verification Step Before Intro
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated display verification screen after waiting to guide users in confirming their pet is visible on their monitor before proceeding.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 3 users reporting pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to display, and median waiting time is 201s. Adding high-performing new screens improves onboarding flow clarity.

new_desktop_display_verification.headline: Is Your Pet Visible on Desktop?
new_desktop_display_verification.body: Look around your screen! If your companion is hidden behind windows, use Alt+Tab or check your system tray.

guard.reason: Adds a valid display verification screen within onboarding before home_intro without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is low (10.5%) and home new_screen previously measured -2.2%.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step after adoption certificate generation so users sign in to save a pet they have already customized and adopted.
candidates.why: Sign-in has a 75.8% conversion rate early in the funnel, and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in. Associating sign-in with saving an adopted pet improves account creation context.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate generation is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 24.2% of users; strong support mail evidence and sign_in reorder measured +3.1%.

candidates.title: Companion Voice & Sound Preview Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated audio testing step during pet pick where users test sound effects and companion voice responses.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the longest step duration (median 89s, mean 1017s) and 3 users reported customization issues. Introducing interactive preview steps engages users during adoption.

new_sound_preview_step.headline: Listen to Your Companion
new_sound_preview_step.body: Test how your desktop pet sounds when greeting you or reacting to your actions.

guard.reason: Inserts an audio testing sub-flow within onboarding while retaining all required steps and functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 25.2%, but adding sub-flows showed no clear benefit in lessons (-0.2% measured).

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Spotlight Redesign for Home Intro
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout focusing on desktop interaction keybinds and companion controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding. Restructuring the final step emphasizes core controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to bring up quick actions, or press your hotkey to invoke them instantly.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro within allowed onboarding bounds while retaining key interaction instructions.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns generally underperform; finish redesign measured modest +0.5%.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Clarification Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear account safety hint on the sign-in screen informing users that sign-in preserves their pet state across desktop restarts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Giving clear expectation of state persistence reassures users.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your desktop pet memory, customization, and progress are backed up automatically.

guard.reason: Adds an informational account persistence hint to the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config hint directly addressing 8 support tickets on account persistence.

candidates.title: Desktop Search Tip on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Adds a rotating tip on the waiting screen explaining how to locate pets if multi-monitor displays or overlay windows hide them.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time is 2336s and support emails report pets missing on initial display. Providing specific display tips reduces friction during generation.

components.text: Using multiple monitors? Your pet will appear on your primary screen by default.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful multi-monitor display tip carousel to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config tip for wait screen; home wait_info measured +1.2% previously.

candidates.title: Spotlight View for Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Changes pick_friend layout to spotlight mode to focus on one pet archetype at a time with clear visual highlights.
candidates.why: Layout changes have yielded strong results (+8.7% measured in previous weeks). Adoption step takes a median of 89s.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend to a spotlight layout while keeping its core job of pet selection intact.

candidates.score_note: Adoption drop-off is high, but adoption layout previously measured -0.8%.

candidates.title: Companion Capabilities Overview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a feature showcase screen right before path selection outlining what interactive desktop pets can do.
candidates.why: Adding new screens is the highest performing test type (+15.4% max win). Choose path step median time is 8s, suggesting users decide quickly without full context.

new_capabilities_overview.headline: What Can Your Desktop Pet Do?
new_capabilities_overview.body: Your companion lives directly on your desktop, responding to your workflow, keeping you focused, and playing mini-games.

guard.reason: Adds a feature capabilities overview screen inside onboarding prior to path selection.

candidates.score_note: 8s median time indicates rash exit; new_screen is top historical performer (up to +15.4%).

candidates.title: Generation Time & Progress Bar Clarification
candidates.change: Enables visual progress and time remaining estimation toggles on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (38+ minutes for heavy asset renders). Setting accurate progress expectations prevents users from closing the desktop app thinking it stalled.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with progress indicators and real wait time estimates allowed under fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s); cheap config update with proven wait_info gains.

candidates.title: Centered Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Rebuilds the adoption certificate layout into a centered spotlight certificate card with an explicit confirmation button.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 74.8% conversion rate. A centered redesign gives a sense of completion and ownership before waiting for desktop asset assembly.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your personalized companion has been registered to your device and desktop environment.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate layout while maintaining official adoption registration messaging.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact at adoption, but redesigns consistently hurt or show no effect.
